hooks.command: changed=$(git status --porcelain -- '*.ts' '*.svelte' 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$changed" ]; then exit 0; fi; out=$(bun run lint:fix 2>&1 && bun run check 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out" | tail -n 80; exit 2; fi; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: lint:fix + check on changed ts/svelte files
